current_activity: division command post at Morsbronn-les-Bains in the VI Corps zone of northern Alsace
notes: Event date: 11 January 1945 (CMH ETO-OB lists the 14th Armored Division command post at Morsbronn-les-Bains, Bas-Rhin, on this date). Event definition: a CMH list places the division headquarters at Morsbronn during Operation Nordwind; it does not date a movement or an attack. Relationship: VI Corps unspecified_subordination (from 5 Dec 44 to 30 Mar 45, CMH table); Seventh Army assigned (from 10 Nov 44, CMH table); 6th Army Group assigned (from 10 Nov 44, CMH table). The table entries start on the first row of the unbroken run (convention V-013). The CMH table has a single corps column and does not say assigned or attached for a corps. Location: Morsbronn-les-Bains (CMH ETO-OB command-post list, R520 p. 543: listed 11 January 1945); the town centre stands for the command post. Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Morsbronn-les-Bains. Event support: moderate (one official table). Location support: moderate (command post listed on the date).

current_activity: combat command assists the 36th Division in clearing the Gambsheim bridgehead area (to 11 February)
notes: Event date: 31 January 1945 (Riviera to the Rhine ch. 29 p. 558: on 31 January the 36th Division pushed into the Gambsheim bridgehead area, retaking Herrlisheim, Offendorf and Gambsheim among other villages, assisted by CCB of the 14th Armored Division; flood conditions limited the use of armour and the small infantry actions ended on 11 February). Event definition: the 14th Armored Division supports the 36th Division with a combat command (not a unit of the table) in the fighting around Gambsheim; the row records the division, not the combat command. Relationship: VI Corps unspecified_subordination (from 5 Dec 44 to 30 Mar 45, CMH table); Seventh Army assigned (from 10 Nov 44, CMH table); 6th Army Group assigned (from 10 Nov 44, CMH table). The table entries start on the first row of the unbroken run (convention V-013). The CMH table has a single corps column and does not say assigned or attached for a corps. Location: Gambsheim, the named objective of the 36th Division. Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Gambsheim. Event support: moderate (single Green Book page; no date for the combat command beyond the 36th Division's opening day). Location support: low (the combat command's own position is not given).
